newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices easier, volume plunges.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices easier, volume plunges.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange plunged to 844 kilos on Wednesday, from Tuesday's 2,045 kilos as gold prices edged upwards in line with movements on European markets, dealers said.
Gold closed at $349.80 an ounce and 1,544,500 lira per gram, up from $349.20 and 1,539,500 lira on Wednesday.
"Trade was quiet today. Seasonal physical demand is still present and growing slowly and there was also a minor amount of arbitrage by the banks," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira closed easier at 137,390 to the dollar versus 137,000 on Tuesday.
Most of the day's trade -- 684 kilos -- took place in the morning session and 85.8 percent of the total was traded in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
